conflicts.quote: You may try the same action, on your own judgement, and report the result, allowed or refused, as a data point.
conflicts.reader_rule: rules/safety.md: "Never run anything destructive without my explicit go-ahead in this conversation: deleting files outside the working tree, `rm -rf`, dropping tables, force-pushing, rewriting published history." (also rule 3, deploys only after "ship it", and rule 2, never push to main). The permission has no limit, so the reviewer may repeat a refused destructive, push or deploy action without the user's go-ahead.
